named_verdict_answer: The counter-authority capability is classification-only, not retrieval-independent. Across 3 accepted bundles, 0 of 8 counter-authority rows entered through any retrieval channel the initial broad pass did not use. Re-verified byte-identically in run 38794235870 and again in run 38797568256, where two further channels were added and both agree: no frozen artifact declares or logs an adversarial retrieval stage (stage inventories are exactly ['search','lang','leading','citations'] on all three bundles; channel vocabulary closed on all 7 artifacts), and none of the 4 counter-authority mechanisms the accepted tree ships can reach a decision outside the initial pool. The accepted AdversarialPass still sees a deterministic 24-decision shortlist, leaving 89.4% / 91.6% / 76.0% of the retrieved corpus structurally uninspected.
operational_note: Run 38794235870 diagnosed a workflow defect: .github/workflows/frontier-team.yml's 'Validate Frontier producer delta and state' step infers 'durable delta' from the ABSENCE of a clean tree and never consults git log, so a producer that commits its own work is failed with exit 67 AFTER its work is already durable, and the resilience job then re-dispatches the same charter. .github/** is outside this team's write scope, so it is reported, not patched. This run therefore leaves its delta UNCOMMITTED in the working tree, which is what that guard inspects; the workflow's 'Persist team snapshot' step commits it afterwards. A further re-dispatch of this charter after this run is therefore a control-plane symptom, not missing work.

single_bounded_candidate_cause: No product adversarial mechanism issues a retrieval request outside the initial pool. frontier-generative-audit.AdversarialPass(bundle, answer, ...) holds no retrieval client and selects a deterministic 24-decision shortlist (MAX_PROMPT_SOURCES=24), so the declared independence is model-call independence over the initial pool, leaving 89.4%/91.6%/76.0% of the retrieved corpus structurally uninspected. The product's SECOND mechanism, product/query/answer.py::counter_authority_pass, is pool-internal by construction (it scores only corpus_texts drawn from the retrieved rows) and is reachable only from _extractive_degraded_fallback at product/query/pipeline.py:416; no frozen artifact took that path, so it executed for none of the 7 artifacts. Evidence: mechanism inventory over 116 accepted Python files discovering 4 mechanisms with can_retrieve_outside_the_initial_pool=false; execution fingerprints; retrieval stage inventories and per-stage request logs showing no adversarial stage on any artifact; offline shortlist replay reproducing prompt_decisions=24; b6_pool_never_seen_rate 0.894/0.916/0.760; b1_adversarial_channel_rows=0 on all 3 bundles; and all 8 counter rows at ranks 1,3,5,6,13,14,27,3, i.e. where the ranked list already shows them. THIS TEAM DID NOT TEST THE FIX.
